subject.title: Session bloat: skillsSnapshot and systemPromptReport accumulated on every run

question: What durable shape should replace inline per-session `systemPromptReport` storage while preserving bootstrap warning dedupe and session compatibility?
rationale: The remaining fix is not purely mechanical because current source intentionally persists the report for warning dedupe, while field data shows the full report now dominates session-store size.

options.title: Persist Minimal Report State
options.body: Store only the small warning-dedupe state in session rows and make bulky report sections recomputable, diagnostic-only, or transient.

options.title: Use Out-of-Line Report Blobs
options.body: Move large report payloads to content-addressed storage similar to skill prompts, with compact refs in session rows.

options.title: Retain Inline Reports
options.body: Keep the current inline design and rely on pruning/capping, accepting continued duplicated metadata in retained rows.

recommendation.title: Persist Minimal Report State
recommendation.body: Store only the small warning-dedupe state in session rows and make bulky report sections recomputable, diagnostic-only, or transient.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the prompt-report feature and authored the adjacent prompt-blob mitigation, making him the clearest routing owner for the storage-policy choice.
